sources_considered.why: Primary research explanation distinguishes projected public-text exhaustion from a complete halt in capability progress.
Primary research reports reasoning improvements through reinforcement learning; relevant to possible workarounds but not proof of progress after general data exhaustion.
Reporting on the Epoch study; the primary source was available.

evidence_items.locator: Opening summary; see also Results and Discussion
evidence_items.explanation: This projects exhaustion of public human text; it does not report that exhaustion occurred. The discussion explicitly allows continued progress through other data, improved data efficiency and different training choices.

The authors report reasoning improvements without human-labeled reasoning trajectories. This is relevant counterevidence to assuming that more human annotations are always necessary, but it does not establish that the forecast's exhaustion condition occurred.

unresolved_gaps: No verified exhaustion of the relevant usable training-data supply was established.
No demonstrated permanent capability ceiling caused by data exhaustion was found.
The speaker supplied no deadline against which quickly-approaching can be scored.
